mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/xlsx-cell-style.test.ts:cell style selection executes27 saved outcomes and atomic refusals
outcomes: The wrapper reports no failures and exactly 27 passed cases across the two shared outlines. Pinned bindings compare requested indices and change receipts, preserve all nonworksheet payloads and selected worksheet source, and require unsafe inputs to refuse with unchanged archive and cached cell state.
gaps: The two native expressions check aggregate results only; semantic assertions are delegated to the pinned bindings. Positive cases use byte reopen, no disk save; custody checks examine the edited live package, with byte equality for no-ops. Refusal codes are only constrained to the xlsx- prefix. The title saying saved outcomes does not establish filesystem persistence.
